surviving_claim: In the tested single-writer local fixed-page model, arithmetic primary addressing removes comparison-index traversal from the primary lookup path while preserving process-crash atomicity under the tested dual-page-copy plus dual-superblock fsync protocol. Single-generation lookup used at most eight user-space os.pread calls, active two-generation missing lookup used fourteen, and source migration remained bounded at eight slots/rows.
non_claims: os.pread and os.pwrite invocation counts are not OS, filesystem, or storage-device I/O counts and may be served from cache
the tested SIGKILL protocol does not establish arbitrary hardware power-loss torn-write behavior
exceptional exact-key overflow is not integrated into the fixed-page commit protocol yet
sparse-file logical size and allocated-byte measurements are not a production space-amplification guarantee
no multi-writer, distributed-consistency, production-latency, or device-write-amplification claim
